input.title: Label the comment textarea with the "Leave a comment" heading
input.rationale: The textarea at offset 430 has no accessible name, so screen reader users hear only "edit text" with no purpose. The section heading directly above it (h2 id="comment-heading", "Leave a comment") already names the field on screen. Pointing aria-labelledby at that heading gives the textarea the same name sighted users see, and it doesn't change the layout. A visible <label> element would be a good addition later, but that needs a markup change that edit ops can't make here. Please check the result with a screen reader. This fixes this one finding; it doesn't mean the page is compliant.
